evidence_quotes.O: I've been doing photography for years as a hobby - I've got all the fancy stuff and filters for everything.
evidence_quotes.C: A correction to the amazon description: According to the box, it only holds up to 450 DVDs (not the 564 they list)
evidence_quotes.E: I was excited to see Yongnuo introduce a new model - I love their flashes, the CTR-301P transmitters and the RF-602 transmitters.
evidence_quotes.A: I'll start off by saying that this item IS compatible with the Rebel XTi (I've seen conflicting information floating around).
evidence_quotes.N: This made long-exposes such as night photography difficult for me and often left me disappointed with the results.
